title: svyder: Design Effect Ratio Diagnostics for Bayesian Survey Models
text: fit Bayesian hierarchical model complex survey data — weighted pseudo-posterior — posterior automatically reflect sampling design. usual repair rescale whole posterior toward design-based sandwich variance. Applied every parameter mistake: within-group covariate genuinely needs interval widened, shrinkage-protected random effect -group coefficient gets already-narrow interval crushed. svyder computes per-parameter Design Effect Ratio (DER) — ratio parameter’s design-based sandwich variance model posterior variance — uses correct parameters need . DER > 1 — posterior understates design uncertainty → widen . DER ≈ 1 — already calibrated → leave alone. DER < 1 — posterior already wider target → correcting wrongly narrow destroy shrinkage protection.

title: Classify Parameters by Design Sensitivity — der_classify
text: tier closed-form DER signature decomposition theorems (\(B\) shrinkage factor, \(J\) number groups): Tier -(within-group fixed effects): \(\mathrm{DER} = \mathrm{DEFF}\) – fully exposed design primary correction candidates. Tier -b (-group fixed effects): \(\mathrm{DER} = \mathrm{DEFF}\,(1 - B)\) – shielded shrinkage usually threshold. Tier II (random effects): \(\mathrm{DER} = B\cdot\mathrm{DEFF}\cdot\kappa(J)\), finite-group correction \(\kappa(J) = 1 - 1/[J(1-B)+B]\). Tier III (hyperparameters, e.g. \(\sigma_\theta\)): excluded construction outside declared location-block DER target. Reported $excluded, never flagged.

title: svyder 0.2.0
text: der_compute() now requires sandwich aggregation unit explicitly via cluster argument (design PSU ids design-based target, group model-aligned target). default: aggregation unit part variance-target definition, DER values can change materially targets. psu retained deprecated alias emits warning. Gaussian score fix: weighted score residual gaussian family now w * (y - mu) / sigma_e^2, matching bread’s working weights w / sigma_e^2. previous residual w * (y - mu) made sandwich — hence DER — scale like sigma_e^4 change response units, gaussian DERs wrong factor sigma_e^4 whenever sigma_e != 1. Binomial results unaffected. meat now stratified, centered within strata, DF-corrected default (strata, center_meat = TRUE, df_correct = TRUE). Set center_meat = FALSE, df_correct = FALSE (strata = NULL) reproduce v0.1.0 results exactly. der_correct() methods renamed: previous per-parameter sqrt(DER) rescaling now method = "marginal"; new default method = "block_cholesky" transforms flagged block jointly covariance matches sandwich target (two coincide exactly one parameter flagged). method = "cholesky" ambiguous now errors guidance. der_decompose() computes protection factor R_k structurally working-weighted within/split covariate; longer back-solved observed DER, made predicted-vs-observed comparison circular. Output columns renamed: deff_mean -> deff_used, B_mean -> B_used (now row-specific). Requires objects created svyder >= 0.2.0 (store $data slots).

title: svyder 0.2.0
text: der_compute() gains cluster_strata argument declaring full cluster universe design (stratum every cluster, indexed cluster id). Clusters zero sampled observations — e.g., selected PSUs whose second-stage sample empty — enter meat zero score-total clusters, contributing stratum centering C_h/(C_h-1) correction instead silently vanishing declared target. Leave NULL every realized cluster least one observation. Weight-normalization conventions: normalize = c("unit_mean", "group_size", "none"). Random-effect DERs invariant weight rescaling, convention part declared target recorded result. Declared-target metadata: results carry $target (aggregation unit, strata, meat options, weight convention, bread convention), displayed print(). Tier III exclusion table: results carry $excluded, listing hyperparameters (sigma_theta, sigma_e gaussian) whose DER undefined, reasons. der_compare() fast path: given svyder object (>= 0.2.0), meat rebuilt per target; y / X / weights need re-supplied. param_types = NULL now infers types design matrix (columns constant within every group fe_between) reports inference via message instead silently defaulting. Optional strata throughout; singleton strata contribute uncentered warning. Fit-object methods (brmsfit, CmdStanMCMC, stanreg) pass cluster, strata, normalize, center_meat, df_correct, beta_prior_sd; survey designs supply first-stage clusters strata.

title: svyder 0.1.0
text: Initial release svyder package. Core pipeline: der_compute(), der_classify(), der_correct(), der_diagnose(). Analysis functions: der_decompose(), der_sensitivity(), der_theorem_check(), der_compare(). Backend support: brms, cmdstanr, rstanarm, survey package.
